entries: {first} found {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, with someone else's name on it.
{MESSAGE:physical} arrived from {SOMEONE:human,!plural}, asking {first} to meet at {landmark}.
The {rival} announced {DISASTER:manmade}, and {first} was the last to hear.
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} moved into {landmark:built}, and {first} could not stop thinking of it.
